mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_current, CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_last
CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN ADD_MONTHS(${alias}stat_date, 12) ELSE ${alias}stat_date END
CASE WHEN NVL(${last}, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((${cur} - ${last}) / ${last} * 100, 0) END
mapper.select: SELECT v.totalDischargeCount, AS totalDischargeCompare, v.dischargedCount, AS dischargedCompare, v.notDischargedCount, AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(m.settlementAmount, 0) AS settlementAmount, AS settlementAmountCompare FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN 1 END) AS totalDischargeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN 1 END) AS totalDischargeLast, COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedLast, COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedLast FROM tr_disch_settle_visit WHERE () ) v, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN charges ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settlementAmount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN charges ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settlementAmountLast FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) m

SELECT
TO_CHAR(v.itemDate, 'YYYY-MM') TO_CHAR(v.itemDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", NVL(v.totalCurrent, 0) AS totalCurrent, NVL(v.totalLast, 0) AS totalLast, AS totalCompare, NVL(v.dischargedCurrent, 0) AS dischargedCurrent, NVL(v.dischargedLast, 0) AS dischargedLast, AS dischargedCompare, NVL(v.notDischargedCurrent, 0) AS notDischargedCurrent, NVL(v.notDischargedLast, 0) AS notDischargedLast, AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(m.amountCurrent, 0) AS amountCurrent, NVL(m.amountLast, 0) AS amountLast, AS amountCompare FROM ( SELECT AS itemDate, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS totalCurrent, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 THEN 1 END) AS totalLast, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedCurrent, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedLast, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedCurrent, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedLast FROM ( SELECT settle_status, AS axis_date,
FROM tr_disch_settle_visit WHERE () ) GROUP BY ) v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AS itemDate, SUM(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN charges ELSE 0 END) AS amountCurrent, SUM(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 THEN charges ELSE 0 END) AS amountLast FROM ( SELECT charges, AS axis_date,
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) GROUP BY ) m ON m.itemDate = v.itemDate ORDER BY v.itemDate

SELECT channel AS name, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS value, NVL(
, 0) AS compare FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN operator_no = '9111' THEN '自助机' ELSE '窗口' END AS channel,
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel

SELECT charge_type AS name, COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS value, NVL(
, 0) AS compare FROM ( SELECT charge_type,
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE charge_type IS NOT NULL AND () ) GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY charge_type

SELECT money_type AS name, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value, NVL(
, 0) AS compare FROM ( SELECT money_type, payment_amount,
FROM tr_settle_payments WHERE money_type IS NOT NULL AND () ) GROUP BY money_type ORDER BY money_type

SELECT charge_type AS name, COUNT(1) AS value, 0 AS compare FROM tr_settle_master WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND charge_type IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN operator_no = '9111' THEN '自助机' ELSE '窗口' END = #{channel} GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY charge_type
